notes.title: MetaFurniture - Cine Tracer v0.7.5.2
notes.content:
This update introduces the new Meta Furniture system that allows for automatic posing.  Please watch the YouTube video tutorial to see how the system works.

Updates:
- When you "Grab" (Hotkey G) an object, it's original transform is saved.  Basically when you Grab move, it won't reset the rotation every time.
- Certain lights were being loaded twice, that is now fixed.
- Department Menu has been reorganized and MetaFurniture "Furniture" category has been added.
- Hovering an object no longer highlights the object and plays a sound.

At the moment only the PC version has been updated to v0.7.5.2.  The MacOS version is still on the previous version.  I'm working on the MacOS version but running into some issues.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: MetaHuman Update
notes.content:
Welcome to Cine Tracer v0.7.5!  This update adds 10 MetaHumans that are semi customizable and updates the game engine to Unreal Engine 4.27.2.  For a walk through on how to pose the MetaHumans and change their clothing please watch the update video on YouTube.

[previewyoutube=sHpqTieWtTg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]This is a major update and there are some changes to be noted:[/b]

1.  This update changed how assets are loaded at run time.  For now we have disabled "Character Building" with the [1-5] Hotkeys.  This functionality will be updated in future updates.  Please use "Editor" building for now.

2.  Many assets have been removed.  If you are in production and want to work on older project, please download the "v0_63" beta branch.  The YouTube video linked to this update shows the process.  Also please backup your project folder in general.

3.  Legacy Cameras, some props, and all characters except "Stand Ins" have been removed in this build.

The memory footprint of the app has been refactored and this build has been confirmed to work on older iMacs as well as the newer M1 Apple laptops.  For PC, 4GB of VRAM is still recommended.

Cheers,

Matt

tags.feature: This update adds 10 MetaHumans that are semi customizable and updates the game engine to Unreal Engine 4.27.2.

notes.title: Cine Tracer v0.61 | Cameras and Storyboard
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QITfp84wdn4;full][/previewyoutube]

In this update the new camera system has been added and there are a new set of cameras.  They have a unified UI and control system with "Marks" and they now save with your project.  There are still some small bugs that need to be fixed but overall the new camera design is functioning.

- Added Dolly with Circle Track
- Re Designed the Tracked "Virtual" Camera system

The Storyboard system has been updated to work with the new more accurate full screen field of view.  However, this means your older storyboards won't have the correct field of view.  Likewise, using the "Legacy" cameras will result in inaccurate storyboard field of view.  You can use an older Beta Branch build if you have a project still using the older cameras and storyboard system.

Tutorials on the new camera system and Tracked Camera are on YouTube.
https://www.youtube.com/cinetracer

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: Cine Tracer v0.60
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WLbpcjguKvI;full][/previewyoutube]

Cine Tracer v0.60 is live on Steam for PC and MacOS.  There are 5 new videos on the Cine Tracer YouTube channels explaining the updates.

1.  New Maps.  I've added two new WIP maps to Cine Tracer.  They are created in a way that should perform well on modest computer hardware and they work with the new system.  I will continue to make new maps for users who are not interested in building set with the building system.

2.  New Props.  I've added some new props.

3.  Face Actors.  The new Face Actors can have their faces controlled by audio or by using the FaceCap App on an iPhone or iPad Pro.  These actors will continue to evolve to support full body motion capture as well.

4.  New Cameras.  The new Free Camera is the first of the newly updated camera system.  It doesn't currently save or work with the storyboard system yet.  The rest of the cameras will be gradually upgraded to this new system.

5.  Inertia Wheels can control the new Geared Head camera.

6.  VR Mode has been implemented.  I have tested the HTC Vive Pro, Vive Pro Eye, and Valve Index.  I'll do my best to support Oculus and Windows Mixed Reality as development continues.

Cheers,

Matt

notes.title: Mac OS Mojave/Catalina "Quitting/Crashing" Issue
notes.content:
Apple recently made some changes to MacOS that require apps to be "Notarized" and also be 64 bit for Catalina.  I'm still currently working on getting it Notarized from Apple, which should fix this issue.

In the mean time, some users report that launching the app DIRECTLY (not from Steam) gets around this issue.

[b]To Launch the Game Directly:[/b]
Macintosh HD⁩ ▸ ⁨Users⁩ ▸ <username> ▸ ⁨Library⁩ ▸ ⁨Application Support⁩ ▸ ⁨Steam⁩ ▸ ⁨steamapps⁩ ▸ ⁨common⁩ ▸ ⁨CineTracer⁩

1. Go to Finder
2. Go to "Go" and hold "Option"
3. Click on "Library"
4. Click on "Application Support"
5. Click on "Steam"
6. Click on "steamapps"
7. Click on "common"
8. Launch CineTracer.app
9. Right Click -> Make Alias for later use

Hopefully when I manage to get the app notarized you will be able to launch the game from Steam again.

Cheers,

Matt

*PC users, same as always

notes.title: IF v0.33 Doesn't Work For You: Read This!
notes.content:
Hey,

Day 2 of Cine Tracer v0.33 and there are some issues being reported.  This is normal, it happens every release.

[b]What Changed?[/b]
- Cine Tracer is made with Unreal Engine and the latest v0.33 version of Cine Tracer is made with Unreal Engine 4.22.2
- The new RTX Options requires Windows builds to have default RHI set to DirectX12 and SkinCache enabled.  These are UE4 things.

For Windows users, this is throwing errors if you don't have DirectX12 SM5 hardware or have Window8 etc.  At least that is what I suspect.

I'm looking into this issue currently, but in the mean time I've made Cine Tracer v0.32 available as a beta branch, so you can still work.


[b]HOW TO USE AN OLDER VERSION:[/b]
- Restart Steam
- Go to Library and Right Click Cine Tracer
- Go to Properties
- Go to Betas
- Select the DirectX11 branch

This will now download and install version v0.32.

It is possible that newer versions of Cine Tracer will require DirectX12 hardware or we will have to maintain two branches, which is not ideal.

Thanks,

Matt

tags.bug: - I'm looking into this issue currently, but in the mean time I've made Cine Tracer v0.32 available as a beta branch, so you can still work.

notes.title: Cine Tracer v0.33 | Real Time Ray Tracing
notes.content:
Hey,

Version 0.33 is live and has the new Real Time Ray Tracing (RTX/DXR) features enabled.  There are also lots of updates that do not require RTX hardware.

Full walk through video is uploaded to the new Cine Tracer YouTube channel: https://youtu.be/v2acAsrzPzI


[b]Notes on Ray Tracing[/b]

NO Apple or MacOS hardware currently supports real time ray tracing.  This doesn't mean that it will NEVER support it.  Windows+DirectX12+Nvidia are just first to support it.

Windows Requirements for Real Time Ray Tracing
- Windows 10 with the latest update.
- DirectX 12 with the latest update.
- Nvidia 1060, 1070, 1080, 1660, 2060, 2070, 2080, RTX Titan or RTX Quadro.
- Latest Nvidia Drivers.

If you don't have these requirements, you will still see the RTX options but they will not actually turn on.

Cheers,

Matt

tags.feature: Version 0.33 is live and has the new Real Time Ray Tracing (RTX/DXR) features enabled.

notes.title: Cine Tracer v0.31 | Storyboard and Stand Ins
notes.content:
Cine Tracer v0.31 just went live.  We have a new dedicated YouTube channel that will host all Cine Tracer content moving forward.

YouTube v0.31 Patch Notes:
https://youtu.be/Gzr6fMwUoAw

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]1. New Storyboard System[/b]
We save the in game storyboards in a new way and the old boards may still load, but moving forward the game uses the new system.
You can now "save" the storyboards by hitting the camera icon and it will save a PNG of the storyboard to your project folder.

[b]2.  New "Grass Mini Map"[/b]
We are going to be creating some small "mini maps" that have specific useful biomes or locations.  These should hopefully load better on lower end hardware.

[b]3.  Stand Ins[/b]
Your old Stand Ins will still be in the game, but you won't be able to make new ones.  Please use the new ones.
The new Stand Ins have better skin/eye shaders and you can give them a name and "Tint" their clothing color.

[b]4.  New Smoke Props[/b]
Look in Props to find them.  The different types of smoke react to light differently.  Smoke #2 requires it to be back lit.

[b]5.  New Screen Prop[/b]
These act like in game signs or power point slides.  Use these to easily add a text call out in your scene.

notes.title: MacOS Support v0.27
notes.content:
Hi!

With [b]Early Release version 0.27[/b] we have [b]added support for OSX/MacOS![/b]

We have officially tested successfully:
[b]- latest iMac Pro (10.13 High Sierra)[/b]
[b]- latest Macbook Pro 10.14 (Mojave)[/b]

We are not able to test on lower/older Macs but from our closed Mac beta we can confirm that at least "some" older Macs/GPUs work.

[b]We cannot back support older MacOS versions or hardware.[/b]  That is not in our control, it is dictated by Unreal Engine, the game engine we use to make the game/app.

[h1]***RTX***[/h1]
Please note that Nvidia RTX / DXR aka "Ray Tracing" aka bounced light/global illumination will likely [b]NOT work on any Mac hardware[/b] in the near future.

If you are looking to buy a new computer and you would like to be able to use the future RTX/DXR version of Cine Tracer, please consider getting a laptop/desktop PC with an Nvidia RTX (20** series) GPU.
***

[b]Please follow us on Instagram to stay up to date: [/b]http://www.instagram.com/cinematographydb

Cheers,

Matt

tags.feature: With [b]Early Release version 0.27[/b] we have [b]added support for OSX/MacOS![/b]
